MatplotBench employs a vision-based scoring mechanism aligned with human assessment , where an advanced multi-modal LLM, such as GPT-4V , is prompted to score the generated figure on a scale from 0 to 100, comparing it with the ground truth figure. Since OpenAI deprecated GPT-4V during our experiments, we adopt GPT-4o, a more powerful version with enhanced vision capabilities, as the recommended replacement by OpenAI , to serve as the scoring model.
